summary: Round-2 fixes all land cleanly. LinkedHashMap consistency restored in logEventOther, /stop-in-group symmetry test added, three additional INFO/WARN log sites wired up (worker-start, worker-success, bot-lookup-missed). Cascade-ordering behavioural test and bot-lookup-hoist were correctly deferred — both round-1 suggestions were explicitly marked optional. The new no-cause-chain rethrow design preserves the original stack trace via setStackTrace, so the throw site is still visible in any logged trace; only the original exception's runtime type is lost (intentional cost of the cause-chain scrubbing). Test code uses the project's existing ListAppender/MockitoSpyBean conventions verbatim (mirror of WebhookSecretVerifierTest / BotServiceTest / TelegramSenderTest). No new findings.

suggestions.suggestion: The fallback when t.getMessage() == null uses t.getClass().getName(), but no test exercises that branch (the round-2 failure test injects a RuntimeException with a non-null message). Add a one-line variant — throw `new NullPointerException()` (message-less) from the upsert stub — and assert reloaded.getProcessingError() equals the FQN. Tiny coverage hole; the fallback is the right behaviour, but the regression net is missing.
suggestions.benefit: Locks in the null-message branch — currently the only audit operators get for an NPE-style failure is the FQN, and a silent regression here would replace it with the bare string "null".

suggestions.suggestion: The rethrown RuntimeException loses the original exception's runtime type (always reported as java.lang.RuntimeException). This is the intentional cost of cutting the cause chain to block token re-leak via t.getCause().getMessage(); the comment on lines 131-134 already documents the trade-off. Optional micro-enhancement: include the original class simple name as a prefix in the rethrown message (e.g. "NullPointerException: " + truncated), already scrubber-safe since the class name cannot contain a token. Restores the most operationally useful piece of type info to JobRunr's `jobrunr_jobs` audit row without re-exposing the cause chain.
suggestions.benefit: Operators reading the jobrunr_jobs `exception` column can still distinguish NPE vs. timeout vs. mongo write failure without checking the worker's own ERROR log.
